description: This file defines a wizard interface for generating a general ledger report in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including form layouts, validation, and report actions.

classes.name: wizard_report
classes.description: A wizard interface class for generating general ledger reports with multiple states and form handling.

methods.name: _get_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default form values based on user and fiscal year data.

methods.name: _check_path
methods.description: Determines the next wizard state based on the model type.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Decides report orientation (landscape or portrait) based on user input.

methods.name: _check_date
methods.description: Validates that the selected date range falls within an existing fiscal year.

methods.name: _check_state
methods.description: Validates and processes the form state, especially date filters.
